name: ailang-parse
description: AILANG Parse — Universal document parsing and generation. Parse documents into structured blocks and generate DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, ODT, ODP, ODS, HTML, Markdown and Quarto — via the hosted MCP server, or via the local `docparse` CLI when documents must not leave the machine. Signs in with OAuth; upload files from a sandbox (createUpload) or an in-chat card (uploadDocument), read long documents in parts, and estimate cost first.
